annotations.title: How to refund a payment (in Stripe)

description: Refunds are never made from a chat: Gemmein's Live Stripe key can't refund, by design. This reads one Live payment (its pi_… from live_revenue or the payment's Logs row) and answers your human's exact steps in Stripe — how much, to which customer, where to press Refund — and what Gemmein does once Stripe confirms it (what the payment unlocked ends, its credits are taken back). amount (minor units, below the payment's) asks the steps for a part refund. Needs the live:read grant, like every Live read; the customer's address follows the "Customer details for AI assistants" switch. Changes nothing and asks nothing; each read is on Live's Logs. This is what a founder may call refunding someone.

amount.description: optional: a part refund, in minor units (pence or cents)

payment.description: the payment's Stripe reference, pi_… or ch_…
